items.name: H, Lanvin & Fils Brut NV, France
items.description: Golden in colour with fine bubbles, this elegant Champagne is fresh on the nose with a rounded toasty palate

items.name: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial NV, France
items.description: Moet & Chandon is the worlds most loved Champagne since 1743. Moet Imperial is the house icon.

items.name: Moet & Chandon Brut Imperial Rose NV, France
items.description: Rose Imperial is a spontaneous, radiant, romantic, expression of the Moet & Chandon style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

items.name: Dom Perignon Brut, France
items.description: A fitting tribute to the genius of the monk from Hautvillers who carried out much research to improve the quality of Champagne, Roughly equal proportions of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay are blended and then left to mature for seven years prior to release.

items.name: Ponte Prosecco, Italy
items.description: Light, Crisp and fruit-forward flavor profile, featuring aromas of fresh apples, pear and white flowers

items.name: Zimor Prosecco, Italy
items.description: Intensity sparkling with light, fresh, apply aromas, Not too dry. Delicate on the nose with a hint of red fruit.

items.name: Lyric Prosecco, Italy
items.description: Light and fresh palate with just the right amount of balanced acidity. Intensely sparkling with light apply aromas, Not too dry on the palate

items.name: Ponte Prosecco Rose, Italy
items.description: Elegant, delicate antique pink, with stunning reflections verging on light rose pink. Fresh and pleasantly fruity, offering delicate citrus notes which sit within a symphony of peach and red delicious apples.

items.name: Domaine Evremond Classic Cuvee NV, England
items.description: English classic sparkling wine. Expect aromatic flavours of orchard fruits, peach and quince, with a touch of white pepper.

items.name: Freixenet 0% Alcohol Free Sparkling Wine, Spain
items.description: Refreshing Tropical notes and elegant citrus hints on the nose, with a lively fruity and well balanced acidity.

items.name: Ocarina Merlot, Central Valley, Chile
items.description: Fruit forward profile featuring rich plum and black cherry flavors. complemented by subtle hints of spice, soft tannin's and a smooth finish.

items.name: Spearwood, Shiraz, South Australia
items.description: Fruity, medium bodied wine, juicy berry flavours, hints of spice and black pepper notes.

items.name: Dead Man's Dice Malbec, Mendoza, Argentina
items.description: Deep and vibrant Malbec with an intense nose of plum damson and dark chocolate aromas.

items.name: Medievo Crianza, Rioja, Spain
items.description: Ruby red colour with purple tinges. Pungent, berry nose with hints of spice, oak, balsamic and toasted notes.

items.name: Bougrier Pure Vallee Pinot Nior, Loire Valley, France
items.description: Light to medium body, bright red fruit flavours cherry, raspberry, strawberry and subtle spice notes and a fresh finish.

items.name: Alta Vista Estate, Cabernet Sauvignon, Mendoza, Argentina
items.description: Rich and full bodied, offering notes of blackberry, cassis, cedar and tobacco, aromas of ripe fruits cherry and strawberry.

items.name: Primitivo di Manduria "Vitti", Puglia, Italy
items.description: Rich, Full bodied, with intense aromas of ripe red fruits, spice, cocoa and vanilla, with a vilverty texture, soft tannins and a long finish.

items.name: Chateau Leret Monpezat, Malbec, Cahors, France
items.description: Powerful and structured red wine from the Cahors region of France. Rich dark flavors black cherry, plum and blackberry, with firm tannins.

items.name: Chateauneuf-du-Pape, Pasquier Desvignes, Southern Rhone Valley, France
items.description: Spicy, warming Character with notes of red and black fruits, vanilla and wild herbs. A blend of Grenache, Syrah and Mourvedre.

items.name: Brunello Di Montalcino, Bartoli Giusti, Italy
items.description: IMade from 100% Sangiovese grapes, known for its elegance and structure, with notes of red fruit, spice and herbs. A complex and harmonious wine.

items.name: Tignanello Antinori, Italy
items.description: Is a deeply intense ruby red colour. On the nose, it's remarkably complex notes of ripe red fruit, black cherries, sour cherries that merge with sweet hints of vanilla, mint and delicate sensations of white pepper and myrtle.

items.name: Vignana Pinot Grigio DOC Delle Venezie, Italy
items.description: Crisp and light bodied wine, with a refreshing profile of citrus and orchard fruits.

items.name: Spearwood, Chardonnay, Australia
items.description: Fresh, light, with flavours of citrus, white peach and melon, with a crisp finish

items.name: Cloud Island Sauvignon Blanc, Malborough, New Zealand
items.description: Crisp & aromatic, with vibrant notes of citrus, passion fruit and fresh-cut grass, with a refreshing acidity.

items.name: Medievo, Barrel Fermented Rioja Blanco, Spain
items.description: Brilliant golden colour, full and round with a buttery texture, beautifully offset by crisp, refreshing acidity and a lingering slightly salty or flinty finish

items.name: Domaine de La Baume, "Elisabeth" Viognier, Languedoc, France
items.description: Aromatic, fruity and full-bodied profile with notes of apricot, peach and honeysuckle, balanced by a creamy texture and a hint of spice.

items.name: Inviniti Lawson's Hills, Pinot Gris, Marlbrorough, New Zealand
items.description: Fragrant notes of pear, apple and citrus, with a rich textural palate that is typically dry with balanced acidity and a clean finish.

items.name: Gavi, Terre del Barolo, Piedmont, Italy
items.description: Crafted from the native Cortese grape, it features notes of lemon zest, almond and delicate white florals. It is light, elegant and finishes with a refreshing, mineral driven acidity.

items.name: Clos du Bois, Chardonnay, California, USA
items.description: Blending French Wine making techniques with ripe, vibrant California fruit. It features bright aromas of apple, pear and citrus alongside creamy notes of vanilla, toasted oak and butter.

items.name: Domaine Raimbault-Pineau Cuvee Prestige, Sancerre Blanc, Loire, France
items.description: Known for its crisp acidity, minerality and aromas of citrus, green apple and white flowers, a fresh and vibrant wine.

items.name: Vignana Pinot Grigio Blush, Delle Venezie, Italy
items.description: Light, crisp and refreshing rose, with a smooth palate with delicate citrus and red fruit notes.

items.name: Fox Hollow, Zinfandel Rose, California, USA
items.description: AA crisp, off-dry Californian blush wine, bright fruit profile, with vibrant notes of ripe strawberries, redcurrant and melon.

items.name: Sieur d'Arques Cuvee du Soleil, Pays d'Oc, France
items.description: Expressive aromas of exotic fruits, with a palate that is bright and refreshing, beautifully balanced with a crisp line of acidity and smooth finish.

items.name: Chantrose, Cotes de Provence, France
items.description: Pale pink in colour, Intense nose with a touch of red berries. Aromas of strawberries and gooseberries and floral notes of roses and honeysuckle.

items.name: Chateau d'Esclans "Whispering Angel", France
items.description: Flavours of redcurrant, dried flowers and spices on the nose, with a subtle herbal quality, Dry, with bitter red fruit flavours
